topics.title: Adverbs of Quantity & De Article Replacement Rule
topics.objective: Express quantities using adverbs of quantity (beaucoup de, peu de, un peu de, assez de, trop de) and apply the rule where de/d' replaces partitive and indefinite articles before nouns.

topics.title: Cardinal Numbers & Counting Rules (0-100, Hundreds, Thousands & Plural Rules)
topics.objective: Master French cardinal numbers from 0 to millions, including compound number construction, hyphenation rules (traditional vs 1990 spelling rectifications), plural agreements for *cent* and *vingt*, and nominal usage with *de* for *million* and *milliard*.
